entries.description:
Identifying the Transformations from the Equation
1. Write the function in the form
(y − c)/k = f(a(x − b))
2. Identify the transformations:
a. The vertical transformations are in this order:
Dilate by factor k
Translate right by c
b. The horizontal transformations are in this order:
Dilate by factor 1/a
Translate right by b
Remember that a negative dilation factor means a reflection.
You can do all vertical transformations first, or all horizontal transformations first, since they are independent.
There is always more than one correct sequence.
To avoid making mistakes, always follow this method to find a valid sequence.
